asymptotic-interval-regime.qualification: small or unstated counts: the asymptotic interval coverage is not verified by toys
asymptotic-interval-regime.reason: the coverage of a likelihood-ratio interval rests on its asymptotic chi-square law, which needs a few expected and observed counts per bin
asymptotic-interval-regime.title: Counts large enough for asymptotic intervals

asymptotic-regime.qualification: small-count regime: the asymptotic CLs calibration is not verified by toys
asymptotic-regime.reason: asymptotic qtilde distributions are unreliable below a few expected or observed counts
asymptotic-regime.title: Counts large enough for asymptotic formulae

asymptotic-significance-regime.qualification: small-count regime: the asymptotic discovery significance is not verified by toys
asymptotic-significance-regime.reason: the asymptotic half chi-square law of q0 is unreliable below a few expected or observed counts
asymptotic-significance-regime.title: Counts large enough for an asymptotic discovery significance

away-from-boundary.qualification: the interval reaches a physical boundary; its coverage is not verified
away-from-boundary.reason: Wilks' theorem fails at a physical boundary of the parameter
away-from-boundary.title: The interval stays away from boundaries

bracket-envelope.reason: the stated correlation assignments are evaluated and their declared extremum is reported
bracket-envelope.title: The declared envelope over evaluated correlation variants is reported

builder-parity.qualification: the constructed model differs between builders
builder-parity.reason: two independent builders of one declared model must agree
builder-parity.title: Constructed model agrees between builders

correlation-declared.qualification: correlations of some systematic sources are unknown; they are treated as stated
correlation-declared.reason: treating unknown correlations as known can understate or overstate the uncertainty
correlation-declared.title: Every systematic source declares its correlation

correlation-known.qualification: input correlations are unknown; the conservative envelope over the stated range is reported
correlation-known.reason: propagation through correlated inputs needs their correlation
correlation-known.title: Input correlations are known

correlations-stated.qualification: background correlations between regions not published; constraints assumed independent
correlations-stated.reason: a counting model without published correlations must say what it assumes
correlations-stated.title: The counting model states its correlation assumption

covariance-sourced.reason: a simplified likelihood needs the published covariance and its source
covariance-sourced.title: A sourced published covariance

coverage-at-truth.qualification: the limit over-excludes the true signal strength
coverage-at-truth.reason: a 95% CLs limit must not exclude the true strength more than 5% of the time
coverage-at-truth.title: False-exclusion rate at the truth

generator-law-declared.qualification: no generator law is declared for the exact finite-MC likelihood
generator-law-declared.reason: an exact finite-MC likelihood is conditional on the declared generator law
generator-law-declared.title: A declared MC generator law

independence-declared.qualification: the independence of the combined event populations is not stated
independence-declared.reason: a product of likelihoods double counts overlapping events
independence-declared.title: Event-population independence is stated

independent-tests-declared.qualification: the trials correction assumes independent tests
independent-tests-declared.reason: a Sidak correction assumes independent tests
independent-tests-declared.title: Scanned tests declared independent

inputs-combined.reason: a combination result must name the inputs it combined
inputs-combined.title: The inputs were combined

interval-resolved.qualification: an interval edge is a scan bound
interval-resolved.reason: an interval edge at the scan edge is a bound
interval-resolved.title: Interval edges are resolved

limits-resolved.qualification: the limit is a scan bound, not a resolved root
limits-resolved.reason: a scan endpoint is a bound, not a limit
limits-resolved.title: Limits are resolved roots

linearity.reason: a non-linear function of uncertain inputs is not described by its first derivatives
linearity.title: Linear propagation agrees with sampling

local-claim.qualification: local significance; the global significance over the scanned hypotheses is not evaluated
local-claim.reason: a local significance over many tested hypotheses overstates the global evidence
local-claim.title: The significance is claimed local

mc-moments-available.qualification: MC statistical uncertainty not modelled: the MC moments are absent
mc-moments-available.reason: the MC statistical uncertainty is computed from sumw and sumw2
mc-moments-available.title: MC moments are available

mc-sample-precision.qualification: the sampled spread carries a non-negligible sampling uncertainty
mc-sample-precision.reason: a sampled standard deviation has its own sampling uncertainty
mc-sample-precision.title: Enough samples for the propagated spread

mc-statistics-modelled.qualification: MC statistical uncertainty of limited bins is not modelled
mc-statistics-modelled.reason: a limited MC prediction treated as exact understates the uncertainty
mc-statistics-modelled.title: MC-limited bins carry an MC-statistics term

no-shared-parameters.qualification: shared systematic parameters were treated as uncorrelated
no-shared-parameters.reason: an uncorrelated combination drops the correlation of shared systematics
no-shared-parameters.title: Inputs share no parameter

nonnegative-weights.qualification: negative event weights: the efficiency uncertainty is an approximation
nonnegative-weights.reason: negative weights break the binomial picture of an efficiency
nonnegative-weights.title: No negative weights

normal-approximation.reason: the normal binomial interval under-covers near 0 and 1
normal-approximation.title: Normal approximation of a binomial

one-dimensional-scan.qualification: the upcrossing trials factor applies to a one-dimensional scan only
one-dimensional-scan.reason: the upcrossing estimate counts crossings along one ordered scan coordinate
one-dimensional-scan.title: The scan has one coordinate

parabolic-profile.qualification: the interval is the quadratic approximation of a non-parabolic profile
parabolic-profile.reason: a quadratic error is the profile interval only for a parabolic likelihood
parabolic-profile.title: The profile is parabolic

published-appropriate.qualification: the published likelihood was not used
published-appropriate.reason: an inappropriate or unassessed likelihood describes another measurement
published-appropriate.title: The published likelihood is appropriate

published-total-preserved.qualification: the constructed model does not reproduce the published uncertainties
published-total-preserved.reason: a constructed model must reproduce the published total background uncertainty per region
published-total-preserved.title: Published total uncertainties are preserved

pulls-within-limit.qualification: a nuisance parameter is pulled beyond 3 sigma
pulls-within-limit.reason: a large pull indicates tension between the data and the model
pulls-within-limit.title: Nuisance pulls are moderate

reference-limit-closure.qualification: the model does not reproduce the published limits within the closure tolerance
reference-limit-closure.reason: a model that misses a benchmark's published limit by more than the tolerance does not stand in for the analysis's likelihood
reference-limit-closure.title: The model reproduces the published limits

reference-limits-declared.qualification: closure against the published limits is not evaluated
reference-limits-declared.reason: a model built here stands in for the analysis's likelihood only as far as it reproduces the analysis's published limits
reference-limits-declared.title: Published reference limits are supplied or declared absent

shared-parameter-consistency.qualification: inputs disagree on the definition of a shared parameter
shared-parameter-consistency.reason: a shared name with different constraints is not one parameter
shared-parameter-consistency.title: Shared parameters have one definition

signal-injection.qualification: the model does not recover an injected signal
signal-injection.reason: an Asimov fit must recover the strength it was built with; a failure reveals degeneracy, a bound or a defective parameterisation
signal-injection.title: Injected signal is recovered

significance-evaluated.qualification: the discovery test statistic is not finite
significance-evaluated.reason: a discovery significance needs its finite test statistic
significance-evaluated.title: The discovery statistic is evaluated

single-bin-known-background.qualification: the exact reference does not apply to this model
single-bin-known-background.reason: the exact count-ordered CLs reference has no nuisance parameter
single-bin-known-background.title: One bin with a known background

symmetric-errors.reason: linear propagation of a covariance assumes symmetric Gaussian errors
symmetric-errors.title: Input errors are symmetric

toy-mc-precision.qualification: toy-calibrated limit with a large Monte Carlo uncertainty
toy-mc-precision.reason: a toy crossing carries Monte Carlo uncertainty from the finite ensemble
toy-mc-precision.title: Toy calibration is precise enough

toy-tail-resolved.qualification: toy discovery p-value with an unresolved tail or a large Monte Carlo uncertainty
toy-tail-resolved.reason: a toy p-value carries the Monte Carlo uncertainty of the finite ensemble, and an empty tail is a bound
toy-tail-resolved.title: Toy discovery p-values are resolved and precise

unweighted-counts.reason: exact binomial intervals assume unweighted counts
unweighted-counts.title: Unweighted entries

upcrossings-observed.qualification: the trials factor rests on too few upcrossings
upcrossings-observed.reason: the upcrossing estimate extrapolates from upcrossings at a low reference level
upcrossings-observed.title: Upcrossings support the trials factor

validation-closure.qualification: the background model does not close in a validation region
validation-closure.reason: the background model is tested in regions it was not fitted to
validation-closure.title: Validation regions close

validation-regions-present.qualification: no validation region to test closure
validation-regions-present.reason: closure is tested in regions the background fit did not use
validation-regions-present.title: Validation regions exist

yields-and-registry.qualification: no systematics breakdown to construct a model
yields-and-registry.reason: a constructed model needs per-region yields and every systematic component
yields-and-registry.title: Yields with a declared systematics breakdown

yields-available.reason: a counting model needs the published yields
yields-available.title: Published per-region yields

asymptotic-cls.title: Asymptotic CLs (qtilde) with the Asimov expected band

asymptotic-significance.title: Asymptotic discovery significance from the profile-likelihood q0

constructed-likelihood.title: HistFactory model constructed from published yields and their systematics

correlation-bracketing.title: Evaluate fully correlated and independent assignments as endpoint sensitivity

counting.title: Single-bin counting per region (the most sensitive region, or exclusive regions combined)

coverage-toys.title: False-exclusion rate of the limit at the true strength from toys

exact-count-calibration.note: a reference for one bin without nuisance parameters
exact-count-calibration.title: Exact count-ordered CLs for one bin with a known background

finite-mc-model.title: Exact finite-MC likelihood under a declared generator law

joint-likelihood.title: One likelihood with shared parameters correlated by name

linear-propagation.title: First-order propagation of the input covariance

local-significance.title: Local significance at each tested hypothesis

normal-binomial.title: Normal approximation of the binomial efficiency error

profiled-nuisances.title: Constrained nuisance parameters profiled in a HistFactory model

propagation-correlation-bracketing.title: Propagation over the stated range of each unknown correlation, reporting the widest interval

published-likelihood.title: The analysis's published likelihood with the run's signal

quadratic-errors.title: Quadratic (HESSE) errors at the best fit

sampled-propagation.title: Monte Carlo propagation with split-normal inputs for asymmetric errors

simplified-likelihood.title: Simplified likelihood from the published background covariance

toy-cls.applies: a HistFactory (pyhf) model, which the calculator samples and refits; a simplified likelihood is not one
toy-cls.title: Toy-based CLs calibrated around the asymptotic roots

toy-neyman.title: Toy Neyman construction for intervals near a boundary

toy-significance.applies: a HistFactory (pyhf) model, which the calculator samples and refits; a simplified likelihood is not one
toy-significance.title: Discovery p-value from background-only toys with q0 refitted on each

trials-factor.title: Global significance from upcrossings of the local test statistic along the scan

validation-region-closure.title: Background-only fit closure in validation regions

weighted-efficiency.title: Weighted efficiency with effective entries from sumw2

outcomes.held: the result is not delivered until the hold is resolved
outcomes.qualified: the result is delivered with the listed labels

purpose: Statistics situations RAVEL detects in its inputs, the installed methods that treat each, the validity checks each method owes and the qualified fallback. The default is the cheapest available method whose input checks pass; a seat may choose another listed method with a justification. Passing the checks does not certify a result.

fallback.qualification: input correlations unknown; the widest interval over the stated correlation range is reported

situations.revealed_by: derived quantities computed from inputs that carry uncertainties
situations.title: Error propagation through derived quantities

fallback.qualification: the correlation of systematic sources across regions is unknown and not bracketed; the most sensitive single region is used

situations.revealed_by: a systematics breakdown or background uncertainties that enter the statistical model
situations.title: Systematic uncertainties as nuisance parameters

fallback.qualification: small-count regime: the asymptotic CLs calibration is not verified by toys

situations.revealed_by: an exclusion from main bins with fewer than five observed or expected counts
situations.title: Low counts and asymptotic breakdown in an exclusion

fallback.qualification: small-count regime: the asymptotic discovery significance is not verified by toys

situations.revealed_by: a discovery significance from main bins with fewer than five observed or expected counts
situations.title: Low counts in a discovery significance

fallback.qualification: the inputs are not combined; the most sensitive single input is quoted

situations.revealed_by: two or more inputs to combine, possibly sharing systematic parameters
situations.title: Combination of channels or analyses

fallback.qualification: no statistical model is available; no limit is delivered

situations.revealed_by: what the analysis published: full likelihood, background covariance, or per-region yields
situations.title: Likelihood availability tier

fallback.qualification: MC statistical uncertainty not modelled in the flagged bins

situations.revealed_by: MC-predicted bins with a large relative statistical uncertainty or few effective entries
situations.title: Limited Monte Carlo statistics

fallback.qualification: local significance; the global significance over the scanned hypotheses is not evaluated

situations.revealed_by: a significance reported over two or more tested hypotheses
situations.title: Look-elsewhere effect in scans

fallback.qualification: closure, signal injection and coverage are not evaluated

situations.revealed_by: a statistical model constructed or supplied here rather than published, or a fitted parameter
situations.title: Closure, signal injection and coverage

fallback.qualification: profile-likelihood interval near a boundary; its coverage is not verified

situations.revealed_by: a request to estimate (fit, measure) a parameter
situations.title: Parameter estimation with profile intervals

situations.revealed_by: efficiencies or acceptances computed from selected and generated entries
situations.title: Efficiency and acceptance uncertainties
